since_year.description: Filter results to include only information published after the specified year. Default to the current year if not provided.

message.content:
Beneath the wide, unending sky,  
A single thread of hope takes flight—  
A kite, a whisper in the wind,  
A fleeting dream that soars so bright.

Its colors splash against the blue,  
Like paint upon a canvas new;  
Each gust a brushstroke, wild and free,  
A dance of light across the sea.

It climbs above the rooftops tall,  
Past laughing children, past the mall;  
It weaves through clouds like silver lace,  
A fleeting glimpse of grace and grace.

And when the day begins to fade,  
The kite descends, its journey made;  
It lands upon the grass below,  
A story told in soft, slow glow.

So let your heart take up the line,  
And feel the wind that makes it shine;  
For in each kite that lifts and flies,  
We find the joy that never dies.
